source_text: Octava dies mysterium resurrectionis et futuri saeculi. Infans praevenitur gratia. Abraham centenarius: fides naturam senescentem vivificat.
pass_a_gloss: Eighth day mystery of-resurrection and of-future age. Infant is-anticipated by-grace. Abraham hundred-year-old: faith nature aging makes-alive.
pass_b_english: The [[eighth day >> Bible:Genesis 17:12]] is a mystery of resurrection and of the age to come. Grace forestalls the infant. Abraham at a hundred: faith makes aging nature live.
